form.div:
Best use: Ask a focused question when you need a quick reading of the customer record.
Features: Grounded answer from account data and timeline without changing customer records.
Priority: Ask one specific question, then verify dates, amounts, commitments, and risks in their source records before making a decision.
🤖 — اسأل أي سؤال عن هذا العميل (الوضع، الصحة، المخاطر، التجديد، آخر التفاعلات…)

field.name: question
field.placeholder: مثال: ليش صحة هذا العميل منخفضة؟ متى آخر تواصل؟ هل فيه فرص بيع؟

button.name: action_ask
button.help: Ask a focused question about this customer. The answer is grounded in the Customer Success record and timeline; verify important facts in their source records before acting.
Close the copilot. The generated answer is advisory and is not written back to customer fields or sent externally.
